categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in environmental protection, focusing on industrial environmental governance and clean production, municipal environmental governance engineering, environmental project operation including sewage treatment plants and sanitation integration, and comprehensive environmental consulting services. Its business covers the entire environmental industry chain including consulting, design, environmental impact assessment, testing, R&D, equipment manufacturing, engineering construction, investment, and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include UMAR/UCAR anaerobic reactors, UBEF biofilters, UHOFe Fenton and E-MOC electro-catalytic oxidation for industrial wastewater treatment, advanced chlorine dioxide preparation systems for pulp bleaching, soil remediation technologies including bio-leaching and thermal desorption, aluminum electrolysis dross treatment technologies, and wet chemical recycling technologies for spent lithium batteries. The company employs system integration (EP), engineering procurement construction (EPC), PPP, BOT, and O&M operational models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large and medium-sized enterprises in industries such as pulp and paper, chemical, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, and energy sectors, as well as government entities and municipal authorities. Major markets include domestic Chinese regions and international markets in Southeast Asia, North America, South America, Eastern Europe, and West Africa, with a strong presence in industrial wastewater treatment and municipal environmental projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, including regions such as Guangxi, Hunan, Anhui, Guangdong, Hubei, Yunnan, and others, with significant overseas operations in Indonesia, Malaysia, Canada, India, the United States, Russia, Turkey, and South America. It maintains a global footprint with a focus on ASEAN countries and expanding presence in North and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, providing integrated environmental solutions including technology development, equipment manufacturing, engineering construction, and project operation services. It also engages in upstream R&D and innovation activities to support its product and service offerings.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end environmental equipment manufacturing, maintaining leadership in industrial pollution control technologies, expanding rural and township sewage treatment and resource utilization, developing solid waste and hazardous waste treatment technologies, and pioneering lithium battery recycling technologies. The company emphasizes innovation in carbon capture and utilization (CCUS), biomass energy valorization, electro-catalytic oxidation, near-zero discharge wastewater treatment, and smart sanitation equipment. It invests heavily in R&D, holds numerous patents, and collaborates with top universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales of environmental equipment, engineering construction contracts (EPC and EP modes), operation and maintenance services of environmental infrastructure (PPP, BOT, O&M models), and professional technical services including environmental consulting, impact assessments, and testing. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic and internationally competitive environmental protection brand with strong core technologies and comprehensive service capabilities. It has broken foreign technology monopolies in key areas such as chlorine dioxide preparation for pulp bleaching and anaerobic wastewater treatment. It faces competition from other large environmental service providers and equipment manufacturers but maintains a competitive edge through innovation and integrated service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, a 20.56% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 865 million, a significant decline. The company has a high asset-liability ratio of 84.38% with total liabilities around RMB 7.94 billion. Despite recent losses, the company is actively restructuring, focusing on industrial segments with stable order backlogs of about RMB 1.73 billion, and expanding overseas markets. It has substantial R&D investment and a large workforce dedicated to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value through proprietary core technologies, such as advanced anaerobic reactors, electro-catalytic oxidation, and large-scale chlorine dioxide systems that break foreign monopolies. It offers integrated environmental solutions covering the full industry chain, from consulting to operation, with a focus on high efficiency, low emissions, and resource recycling. Its products and services support clients in achieving carbon neutrality and regulatory compliance, while its international presence and technology leadership differentiate it in the competitive environmental protection market.
